checks.command:
python3 -c 'import os, subprocess, sys
paths = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z"]).split(b"\0")
failed = False
for raw in paths:
    if not raw or raw.startswith(b".task-board/"):
        continue
    path = os.fsdecode(raw)
    result = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--no-index", "--check", "--", "/dev/null", path], capture_output=True)
    if result.returncode not in (0, 1) or result.stdout or result.stderr:
        failed = True
        print(path, "exit", result.returncode)
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout)
        sys.stderr.buffer.write(result.stderr)
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)
'
